description: Angular component for audit log filtering, including UI interactions, form management, and overlay panel control.

classes.name: AuditLogFilterComponent
classes.description: Angular component for filtering audit logs with UI controls and overlay panel.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the current filter value and updates the form.

methods.name: predefinedTypeValues
methods.description: Returns predefined action type options for UI.

methods.name: toggleAuditLogFilterPanel
methods.description: Opens overlay panel for filter options.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Applies filter changes and closes overlay.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets form to initial filter state.

methods.name: updateAuditLogFilterForm
methods.description: Updates form with given filter data.

methods.name: auditLogFilterUpdated
methods.description: Updates internal filter state and propagates change.

methods.name: updateButtonDisplayValue
methods.description: Updates button label based on current filter.
